title: const, let, var: which one?
why_it_matters: Picking the right keyword prevents a family of surprise bugs.
explanation: Use const by default: the name can't be pointed at a new value. Use let when you must reassign, like a counter. Avoid var, because it ignores block boundaries and leaks out of if statements and loops.
